nodes.name: Build note
nodes.notes: Handles all three payload types in one node. VAULT is the in-container path (/obsidian), not the host path.

nodes.name: Write to vault
nodes.notes: Native file node — surfaces a real ENOENT if the path is wrong, where fs+mkdirSync would silently create the directory inside the container and write into a layer that vanishes on restart. Does NOT create missing directories: notes/, meetings/ and test/ must exist under /obsidian/notemeet in the container.
